header_note: XRPL-MC forward predictions (SCORE_VERSION 6, scope xrpl-mc): a separate stream with its own genesis and its own sealed 18-pool cohort. Every prediction in this stream is pre-registered FOR LIFE — this store holds only the frozen prediction, and resolution lands in a separate hash-signed grade ledger, so a prediction is never withdrawn from the public set once its outcome is known. Each manifest therefore republishes the complete immutable set, not a delta. record_id is derived from (pool_id, ts) via RFC-8785/JCS; store_record_id and store_prediction_hash are the predictions store's own independently-derived ids, carried for provenance.
